tests.pins: A [CompositeResolver] partial class gets generated source that compiles, implements IFormatterResolver with a static Instance field and GetFormatter, and lists the given resolver, as CompositeResolverGenerator relies on via AddSource(TransformText()).

An enum used by a [MessagePackObject] gets exactly one generated, compiling IMessagePackFormatter<MyEnum> with Serialize and Deserialize members, which MessagePackGenerator.Generate emits via EnumTemplate.TransformText().

Formatters emitted through the template EmitNestingTypesAndNamespaces overloads compile and end up nested inside the namespaced [GeneratedMessagePackResolver] partial class, for data types in deep namespaces and nested in other classes.
